title: Total mindfulness is associated with overall grade
body: Across n = 128 students, total mindfulness correlates with overall grade at r = 0.373 (p < .001).

title: Acting with Awareness is the strongest individual facet
body: Among the five mindfulness facets, Acting with Awareness has the largest association with overall grade: r = 0.356 (p < .001).

title: Dynamics shows the clearest course-specific mindfulness signal
body: The strongest Dynamics association is with Nonjudging: r = 0.303 across n = 38. Because the course-specific sample is smaller, this should be treated as exploratory.

title: GPA-controlled model is now available
body: In the model Overall Grade ~ Total Mindfulness + GPA Category Midpoint, the model explains R² = 0.124. The total-mindfulness coefficient is β = 0.454 (p < .001).

title: Interpretation caution
body: These are associational results. They support the claim that mindfulness traits are related to performance in this sample; they do not by themselves establish that mindfulness causes higher grades.
